Remove the AgentCore runtime agent: First, remove all resources from your local configuration: agentcore remove all Then deploy again to tear down the AWS resources: agentcore deploy Delete the Amazon SageMaker AI endpoint: aws sagemaker delete-endpoint --endpoint-name healthcare-agentcore-endpoint-1 --region us-west-2 Delete the Amazon OpenSearch Service domain: aws opensearch delete-domain --domain-name healthcare-vector-store --region us-west-2 Conclusion In this post, we showed how to migrate a multi-model healthcare AI agent from self-managed Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate infrastructure to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime.
